name: Kentucky
agency: Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (licensing, drive.ky.gov); Kentucky State Police Driver Testing (written and road tests)
permitAge: 15 (instruction permit; lowered from 16 by HB 15, signed 2025-03-25, effective immediately)

teen.supervisedHours: 60 hours, including 10 at night, recorded on a Practice Driving Log signed by the teen and a parent or guardian
teen.holdPermit: 180 days for applicants under 21; 30 days for applicants over 21 (KYTC parent guide); must be at least 16 for an intermediate license
teen.nightLimit: Intermediate license under 18: no driving midnight to 6 a.m. without good cause (school, work, emergency) (KRS 186.452)
teen.passengerLimit: Intermediate license: no more than one unrelated passenger under 20, unless a driver training instructor is present (KRS 186.452)
teen.phone: Drivers under 18 (permit, intermediate or operator license): no personal communication device use while the vehicle is moving, except to report an emergency (secondary source)

School bus: HB 7 (2026), in effect July 15, 2026: opposite-direction traffic must stop on any highway unless separated by a raised/elevated barrier or an unpaved median. The old four-lane exception (KRS 189.370, 2009 text) no longer applies. Sources are news reports; enrolled bill text not read. Reported fines $300 first offense, $500 after.
Move over (KRS 189.930, 2003): change to the lane away from a stopped emergency or public safety vehicle with flashing lights, or slow down if that is unsafe (KYTC).
